name: OpenFigma
tagline: Real-time collaborative canvas with multiplayer cursors and vector tools
description:
A multiplayer design canvas inspired by Figma, complete with live cursor presence, reactions, sticky comments, and SVG vector drawing using Fabric.js and Liveblocks.

Created using Cursor and v0 to experiment with low-latency WebSockets and vector synchronization. The team was blown away by 60fps canvas performance in modern browsers.

replaces.note: Multiplayer design canvas and vector manipulation with zero seat costs.
